mealAnalysis.guidance_message: This meal consists of boiled potatoes, which are high in simple carbohydrates and can cause a rapid increase in blood sugar levels for someone with diabetes. It is best to avoid or strictly limit this meal, opting for whole grain or high-fiber alternatives such as sweet potatoes or legumes instead.
mealAnalysis.meal_description: Four medium-sized boiled potatoes without added fats or seasonings.
